title: Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums: Execution-Bound Evidence Certification and Plausible-World Safety Gating in Agentic Control Planes
abstract: arXiv:2611.32032v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agreement among large language models is not physical evidence for mutating production infrastructure. Because generative models share pretraining priors and conform to peer rationales during deliberation, voting ensembles correlate errors instead of providing independent fault tolerance; yet attaching rigid deterministic checks to unconstrained agent outputs paralyzes incident remediation. We present Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums (PIEQ), an execution-bound certification layer that keeps every language model strictly outside the trusted computing base. translated_title: 溯源隔离认知仲裁团：智能体控制平面中的执行绑定证据认证与可能世界安全门控
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型之间达成的一致意见并不能作为变更生产基础设施的物理证据。由于生成式模型共享预训练先验，并在协商过程中倾向于迎合同伴的推理，投票集成机制只会使错误相互关联，而非提供独立的容错能力；然而，若将僵化的确定性检查强加于不受约束的智能体输出之上，又会使事故修复陷入瘫痪。我们提出了溯源隔离认知仲裁团（PIEQ），这是一种执行绑定的认证层，可将每个语言模型严格排除在可信计算基之外。PIEQ 围绕三项不同的义务，统一了基于假设的真值维护、物理溯源隔离、基于控制论的可能世界安全屏蔽以及可线性化的并发治理：从互不相交的物理故障域认证诊断前提条件，在所有未被反驳的故障世界中对候选变更进行门控，并在条件不满足时回退到只读诊断……
tldr: 该论文提出PIEQ框架，将所有语言模型严格排除在可信计算基之外，通过基于假设的真值维护、物理溯源隔离、可能世界安全屏蔽与可线性化并发治理，为智能体变更生产基础设施提供执行绑定的证据认证与跨故障世界的安全门控。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PIEQ, an execution-bound certification layer that keeps all language models strictly outside the trusted computing base, unifying assumption-based truth maintenance, physical provenance isolation, plausible-world safety shielding, and linearizable concurrency governance to certify evidence before agents mutate production infrastructure.
